name: What should I look for when choosing a builder for ground-up luxury construction?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a builder for ground-up luxury construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a builder for ground-up luxury construction, prioritize experience with custom high-end homes, a strong portfolio of completed projects, and verifiable client testimonials. Look for a builder with transparent communication, a proven project management approach, and strong relationships with architects, designers, and subcontractors. Ensure they are licensed, insured, and familiar with local building codes in areas like Los Angeles. A good builder will also demonstrate financial stability and offer comprehensive warranties.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a builder with extensive luxury home experience, a strong portfolio, transparent communication, a clear process, and proper licensing and insurance.
